mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, target_type, target_id, content, create_time, update_time FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (account_id, target_type, target_id, content) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT c.*, up.nickname AS account_name, up.avatar_url AS account_avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON c.account_id = up.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON c.target_type = 'WORK' AND c.target_id = w.id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON c.target_type = 'REQUIREMENT' AND c.target_id = r.id WHERE (w.owner_id = #{ownerId} OR r.publisher_id = #{ownerId}) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c LEFT JOIN work w ON c.target_type = 'WORK' AND c.target_id = w.id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON c.target_type = 'REQUIREMENT' AND c.target_id = r.id WHERE (w.owner_id = #{ownerId} OR r.publisher_id = #{ownerId})
